crossRefs.note: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel…
His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
“Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and…

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

translations.web: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translations.bsb: From the sons of Issachar, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
translations.kjv: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
translations.asv: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
